name: Sanga Choeling Monastery
town: Pelling (CSV town 'Pemayangtse' is approximate; spelling variant of 'Sanga Choeling')
town_description: Pelling, at about 2,150 m in Gyalshing district of West Sikkim, is Sikkim's premier hill resort town with close views of Kanchenjunga. Nearby attractions include Pemayangtse Monastery, the ruins of Rabdentse (the old Sikkimese capital), Sanga Choeling Monastery (reached on foot up a steep forest track), Khecheopalri Lake and Darap village.
tradition: Tibetan Buddhism (Nyingma) - NOT a Hindu temple

travel.airport: Nearest airport is Bagdogra (IXB), approx. 145 km (verify); Pakyong Airport is closer but has limited flights.
travel.railway: Nearest major railway station is New Jalpaiguri (NJP), approx. 145 km (verify).
travel.road: Reached on foot only via a steep 2-4 km forest track from Upper Pelling; taxi/shared jeep to Pelling from Gyalshing (Geyzing).

visitor_information.best_time: October to May; winter for snow views, summer for clearer mountain views.
visitor_information.opening_hours: One source reports 9 AM-5 PM (verify); visits are normally during daylight hours.
